nodes.name: Receive Alert Webhook
nodes.notes:
Supabase fires this when a row is inserted into grain_alerts.
URL: POST /webhook/grainhero-alerts
Supabase sends the full record as JSON in the request body.

nodes.name: Verify Webhook Secret
nodes.notes:
Security check — rejects any request that does not include
the correct x-webhook-secret header.
This prevents fake alerts from triggering notifications.

nodes.name: Reject — Unauthorized
nodes.notes:
Returns HTTP 401 to Supabase if the secret does not match.
This branch only runs when the secret check fails.

nodes.name: Extract Alert Fields
nodes.notes:
Parses the Supabase webhook JSON payload and extracts
all the fields needed by downstream nodes.
Outputs a clean, flat object with alertId, adminId, siloId,
title, message, priority, severity, metric, value, threshold.

fieldValues.fieldValue: ={{ JSON.stringify({ alert_id: $json.alertId, silo_id: $json.siloId, sensor_type: $json.sensorType, metric: $json.metric, value: $json.metricValue, threshold: $json.threshold, priority: $json.priority }) }}

nodes.name: Insert In-App Notification
nodes.notes:
Inserts a row into the notifications table.
Your React frontend listens to this table via Supabase Realtime
and shows the notification bell/toast automatically.
No frontend code changes needed.

nodes.name: Mark Alert notification_sent
nodes.notes:
Sets notification_sent = true on the grain_alerts row.
This prevents duplicate notifications if the webhook fires twice
(e.g. Supabase retries on timeout). Always the last step.
